stem:
Adeel lines up four children left to right with heights $150\,\mathrm{cm}$, $140\,\mathrm{cm}$, $145\,\mathrm{cm}$, and $142\,\mathrm{cm}$. Each child calls out how many taller children stand in front of that child.

Which two claims correctly describe the height-code?

options.text: The height-code is $0$, $1$, $2$, $3$, counting every child standing in front.
Each number counts only the taller children standing in front of that child.
The height-code is $3$, $2$, $1$, $0$, counting taller children standing behind.

teacher.key_rationale: Left to right: 150 says 0; 140 has one taller in front (150); 145 has one taller in front (150); 142 has two taller in front (150 and 145). So the code is 0,1,1,2, and each entry counts taller children in front only.
